Game Overview

Santa Girl Running is a adventure title where dash through the frosty North Pole as Santa's spirited daughter, collecting scattered gifts while dodging obstacles and foes. Harness the sleigh boost for smashing through barriers and achieve high scores. Navigate vibrant festive landscapes and embrace this exhilarating holiday-themed running adventure.
